summary: UBS AG filed its First Quarter 2026 Report via Form 6-K, a routine financial update for a foreign private issuer. The filing contains standard quarterly financial information, risk and capital management disclosures, and alternative performance measures. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is indicated. The report is a periodic earnings release and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
